title: Describe
description: Generates a natural-language description of an image using a local vision-language model. SmolVLM-500M (Apache-2.0, default) is small and fast; Qwen3-VL 4B and Mage-VL 4B (both Apache-2.0) give richer descriptions on GPU.
The prompt is steerable: ask for a detailed description, focus on specific aspects, or ask questions about the image.
Runs locally with no API key required; the 500M default also runs on CPU and Apple Silicon (MPS).
For object detection use Object Detection. For text reading use OCR.

caption.prompt.title: Prompt
caption.prompt.description: Steers the description. The default asks for a detailed description; you can also focus it ("Describe the people in this image") or ask a question about the image ("What color is the car?").

caption.max_new_tokens.title: Max output tokens
caption.max_new_tokens.description: Hard cap on generated tokens per description. Generation time scales with output length, so this bounds worst-case latency; lower it (e.g. 48) for latency-sensitive pipelines with short prompts.

caption.max_sentences.title: Max sentences
caption.max_sentences.description: Stops generation at a clean sentence boundary once this many sentences have been produced, instead of cutting off mid-sentence at the token cap. Set 0 to disable and rely on max output tokens alone.
